top_signals.title: Futures Muted Ahead of PPI Data, Oracle’s AI-Signaling Results

top_signals.title: Oil Holds Above $100 as U.S.-Iran Tanker War Escalates
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices held near recent highs after rallying sharply earlier this week, with gains driven by an escalation in the U.S.-Iran conflict and intensifying attacks on tankers in the Persian Gulf. Iran reported hits on U.S. warships and tankers in the Persian Gulf, while the U.S. said it had hit ten Iranian tankers. top_signals.title: Forced Into the Right Decision? A Look at U.S. Land-Based Deterrence Posture
top_signals.summary:
In 2019, Steve Fetter wrote “A Cheaper Nuclear Sponge,” in which he argued that building a new intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) was unnecessary for strengthening U.S. land-based deterrence.
